summary_md: **Qixing Zhou ([@QixingZ44506](https://x.com/QixingZ44506/status/2116158345413554225))** open-sources a **Universal Coding Data Factory** that turns GitHub repos into executable, verifiable coding tasks end to end; 4,344 tasks added to MixRL training lifted Qwen3.8-27B's SWE-bench Verified from 70.2% to 79.8% and FeatureBench from 50.3% to 60.3% internally ([LiberCoders/FeatureBench](https://github.com/LiberCoders/FeatureBench)).
